name: Luzuk Photo Gallery
author: luzuk Themes

sections.description:
Luzuk Photo Gallery is a fast, accessible gallery plugin offering Grid, Masonry, Justified and Carousel layouts. It includes a Gutenberg block and shortcode, lazy loading, responsive srcset, and a minimal vanilla lightbox.

Features:
– Grid, Masonry, Justified, Carousel
– Lightweight assets (no jQuery front end, no Bootstrap)
– Responsive images (srcset), lazy loading, SEO-friendly alt/captions
– Accessible (ARIA, keyboard navigation, focus trap) lightbox
– Shortcode [luzuk_gallery id="123" layout="grid|masonry|justified|carousel" cols="3" gutter="12" radius="8" hover="zoom" theme="auto"]
– Gutenberg block “Luzuk Gallery”
– Albums taxonomy, reorderable images via drag & dropLuzuk Photo Gallery is a plugin to create your own Image Gallery section.

Our Shortcodes

  • [luzuk_gallery]

Luzuk Photo Gallery

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install from the Plugins page.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Luzuk Gallery → Add New Gallery, add images and publish.
  4. Insert the gallery via block or shortcode.= Minimum Requirements =
  • PHP version 5.4 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater

We recommend your host supports:

  • PHP version 7.0 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater
  • WordPress Memory limit of 64 MB or greater (128 MB or higher is preferred)

Automatic installation (easiest way)

To do an automatic install of “Luzuk Slider”, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.

In the search field type “Luzuk Slider” and click Search Plugins. Once you have found it you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.

Manual installation

Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  1. Download “luzuk-photo-gallery.zip”
  2. Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  3. Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  4. Select “luzuk-photo-gallery.zip” from your computer
  5. Click ‘Install Now’
  6. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

FTP install

  1. Download “luzuk-photo-gallery.zip”
  2. Extract the “luzuk-photo-gallery” directory to your computer
  3. Upload the “luzuk-photo-gallery” directory to the “/wp-content/plugins/” directory
  4. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard.
sections.faq:
How do I reorder images?

Use the metabox on the gallery edit screen: drag and drop thumbnails to reorder.

Does it load assets on every page?

No. Assets load only when the shortcode/block is present.

Is the lightbox accessible?

Yes. Keyboard navigation (Esc, ←, →), focus handling, and ARIA roles.
